notes.title: New Update 3/1/18 - Swipe turn option added
notes.content:
A new small update is now available with the option to turn around your character by tapping the trackpad left/right. It should give you a more comfortable way to turn your body without messing with your cables by simply tapping the trackpad.
You can also rotate your furniture by tapping left or right on the trackpad.
This update also includes some major bug fixes and improvements.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Home Customization Update is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31142122/2571a7da10ad248681474add62b5666ef3ae4591.jpg[/img]

Harvest Simulator VR has been updated to v1.1 and includes many great new features and improvements.

What's new:
- You can now purchase furniture from the Shop to customize your home
- You can move or delete your placed furniture
- Changed "$" to "Pts." to avoid confusion with the in-game currency
- Changed plant growth time (in Shop) to "+" to better explain how long it takes for each plant to grow (to avoid confusion with in-game days and actual real time days the plants now grow in a couple of in-game hours depending on the plant)
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't sell chicken eggs
- Pressing "New Game" now gives you a warning if a save file already exists
- Other bug fixes and improvements
